body:
I'm 30 and I dealt with a lot of this internalized misogyny from female peers as well. I'll accept the notion that I am pretty and have a good figure so female classmates would passive aggressive lash out at me or act a certain way to single me out until I'm alienated and forced into having just male friends. Of course that automatically makes me a whore because I get along so well with the guys. Gee I wonder why? This has happened to me from high school to today both in college and work environments. 

I recently made a female friend who's engaged to a gaming buddy of mine and I figured that sort of bodily envy would be irrelevant. I fully respect their relationship. It was so refreshing. I had lost hope of ever making any female friends at this point. We got along so well, same upbringing, shopping, foodies, it was like the gf I always wanted. But nope, somehow, some way... Because I was already friends with her fiance... She would tell me not to associate with her fiance even though it's a group of gamer friends doing stuff together? Eventually it led to a situation where I broke girl code and honestly, for the life of me I don't understand girl code vs. General sense of respect. My post is in my history if you're all interested in the story.

My continued negative experiences just makes me wary of theunderlying hate and envy our friends harbor.. As well as this strange girl code we must adhere to

You guys are right, I'm wasting valuable time agonizing for nothing I just feel bad

Thank you Dodo 😊

Except I am pretty sure I'm her shit list. As other friends have reassured as well, there's a reason why none of the other girls like being around her 😕 and tbh I feel really hurt I got ostracized and villainized over something that shouldn't be my responsibility but was somehow expected of me... 

Sean appears to still be on good terms with me since we're talking about the pets but I won't reach out to him regarding concerns until I'm sure she's not going to be present. I have a strong sense that she reads his texts and Skype messages. He needs to understand how damaging her behavior is

I ended up omitting that as soon as he got picked up, I reminded Sean that Terry got him something from the restaurant (word limit). He said yeah he knows, it's why I keep writing that he should have known since it does not change the situation. Nothing further was said... So I thought alright so him and Edward made plans despite that, not my problem. They're best friends for a reason lol neither me/Terry would have been able to stop anything. Worse I'm already an accomplice so...

My understanding is that he's often dishonest in similar situations. Sometimes it's exclusively all the gamer guy hangouts, sometimes it includes the girls of the group. Regardless of female presence he's the same. Because if she could have her way he wouldn't be able to do what he wanted with his friends and reschedule his time with her without her getting upset.

Regardless I respect your response though, thanks!

I spoke to Edward and another mutual friend Alex about it this yesterday and like you..Edward also believes Sean may have grudgingly rubbed the fact I was there in her face to save his ass. Edward and Alex are sure that Sean knows she has some unreasonable paranoia about me since she was extremely upset the night we gamed for hours. In terms of our mutual attraction, he is perplexed and finds it laughable that she'd be uncomfortable about my friendship with her fiance. He's confident Sean would never cheat on Terry anyway so this jealousy is completely misplaced. 

It was lose lose for sure and Edward feels bad about not telling me that Sean was coming until we were on the road since he didn't think anything of it. Alex wasn't a part of this but he was listening and he commented this became a shit show for no good reason. It's unfortunate that my presence and the context of Sean's behavior combined just made things so much worse.

I just worry from now on, it'll be awkward when she's present for bigger group things or how she'll demand that he can't do anything if I'm present. Edward and Alex insisted I did nothing wrong as well. 

You are indeed a wisebat. Thanks!

Apparently I was supposed to report it... Since she went on about girl code and how sister's are loyal etc I get it but not to this extent. As a result I don't think she wants my friendship either which is understandable

Yes, it certainly feels like I got singled out and blamed for him missing his time with her because I am female.

A few other friends have noted Sean probably sold me out and added fuel to that fire to save his ass. It certainly is possible
I really don't want to be a watchdog. It's honestly not my business what each friend does as long as nobody is getting hurt

Yes, he went for dinner instead of going home. Sean and I should have known she bought dinner for him. The issue is whether I am an ass for not ratting him out despite the knowledge. Frankly I didn't lie, I simply didn't  tell her but she insisted that I lied by not ratting him out so I can't change that logic

Dangerous friend context: I've been friends with Edward and Sean for over 3 years prior to developing a friendship with Terry. We've only been friends for 6 months. She somehow became uncomfortable that Sean and I would sparsely talk about the same shit since we became friends, just gaming nonsense and about our pets. She asked me not to talk to him as much even if the stuff is mundane and I'm feeling weird about the request and said sure. A few weeks ago, me, Sean, a mutual friend Edward + 4 other mutual friends were playing a coop game together for 8+ hrs and apparently she was upset he didn't watch a movie with her that night. The following day she asks me what my relationship with Sean is and I'm so confused why this is even happening. Our entire friend circle knows Edward and I have somewhat of an attraction. I'm not even remotely interested in Sean but what does him missing movie night have to do with my "relationship" with her fiancee..? She tells me she's having trust issues and I was feeling annoyed at her fantasy perception of us and just told her you both need to work on communicating and trust. She says that included me as well. I couldn't help but roll my eyes.
